fields.name: AVC
fields.note: Stock AVC is the four-bit bitmap of manual AVC0, AVC1, AVC2 and AVC3 at bits 16–19; no reserved gap or encoded-channel conversion.

members.note: AVC[3:0] preserves the stock bitmap spelling of the four contiguous per-virtual-channel flags AVC0–AVC3 in the cited manual table.

types.note: Stock FSP5.9 DSILINK word-register vocabulary. Byte/halfword convenience aliases are not invented: the target manual specifies 32-bit register accesses. The DSI block is not the independent CSI block. RA8P1 reserves RXSCR bit 13, SQCH0SCR bits 16 and 19, and SQCH1SCR bit 16 (HM 66.2.15/55/59); the original driver must not write its RXTE, DABORT or channel-zero SIZEERR masks there.
